mistake_reason: The orchestrator initiated and sustained unnecessary reiterations of the same data retrieval steps (reopening the identical Yahoo Finance VGT/MGK pages and asking to reconfirm the same dates repeatedly) without changing parameters or tools. This FM-1.3 Step Repetition created a loop that delayed progress and led to confusion, causing the WebSurfer to cross-attribute VONG’s Jan 2, 2013 start price (≈38.21) to MGK. The misattribution inflated MGK’s computed percent increase and resulted in the wrong final answer.
